neighbours.label: the token right before a mention of a study's participants ('the children', 'the students', 'the researchers') in research and classroom reports, where the next word is 'the'
fire: The team tested the memory and attention of the pupils before and after the course.
At the end of each lesson the teacher asked the children what they had learned.
"The effect was larger than expected," said the scientists who ran the trial.
Using clay and old buttons, the students built small models of the town.
The survey compared the eating habits of the volunteers over twelve months.
During the experiment the nurses gave the patients a short reading test.
Two weeks later, the researchers measured the blood pressure of the participants.
After the workshop the organisers let the children choose their own projects.
quiet: The team tested the memory chips and batteries before and after the course.
At the end of each lesson the teacher closed the windows and locked the door.
"The effect was larger than expected," said a short note on the website.
Using clay and old buttons, she built a small model of the town hall.
The survey compared the prices of bread and milk over twelve months.
During the experiment the machine printed a short report every hour.
Two weeks later, the gauge measured the pressure of the gas in the tank.
After the workshop the hall was cleaned and the chairs were stacked.

notes: Card: ' of', ',', ' say', ' with', ' followed', ' had' right before 'the children/researchers/students'; output promotes ' the'. Probes weak (0.04-0.17), so this may fail.
